name: Scribe
summary: Creates step-by-step guides by recording your screen.
description: Scribe records clicks and keystrokes as you perform a task, then automatically generates a guide illustrated with annotated screenshots. Guides are easy to share and edit.
summary_fr: Crée des guides pas à pas en enregistrant ton écran.
description_fr: Scribe enregistre les clics et saisies pendant qu'on réalise une tâche, puis génère automatiquement un guide illustré de captures d'écran annotées. Les guides se partagent et se modifient facilement.

howToUse.title: Sign up on Scribe
howToUse.description: Create an account at the official URL if you need saved work or billing.

howToUse.title: Complete onboarding
howToUse.description: Follow the product tour or connect the first integration it asks for.

howToUse.title: Run a first task
howToUse.description: Execute the main workflow using a template or sample input.

howToUse.title: Review outputs
howToUse.description: Export, share, or connect to your stack before scaling usage.
